title: Second independently frozen fresh questions after expanded FAQ first-pass fixes

policy.independence: Written and fixed before inspecting the latest knowledge/retrieval changes; not disclosed before evaluation.
policy.scope: Eight platform questions and two outside-platform questions with similar account/sharing vocabulary.
policy.topic_mapping: Semantically equivalent implementation topic IDs are allowed; judge the answer contents and do not count an unrelated safe answer as correct.

turns.question: Changing my login name will not make my uploads belong to a new account, will it?
required_facts: Editing the login username keeps the same account and uploaded-object ownership.
The account name and optional profile display name are separate.
must_not_claim: Changing the username creates a new owner account or transfers the data.

turns.question: 邮箱后来补上了，是不是就能用邮件找回旧密码了？
required_facts: Email password recovery remains unavailable in the current pilot even if an email is present.
must_not_claim: Adding an email enables a reset-password message.

turns.question: Why did an old sharing notification disappear after the owner removed the dataset?
required_facts: Notifications tied to a deleted object are removed along with that object.
This is distinct from merely marking a notification read.
must_not_claim: All read notifications are automatically deleted.

turns.question: 把提醒设成已读以后，原来的共享权限还在吧？
required_facts: Marking read changes only notification read status.
It does not revoke access or delete the shared data.
must_not_claim: The shared relation is removed when a notification is read.

turns.question: Can I pick just stress_11 and strain_11 for a CSV, without all the other components?
required_facts: The detail plot supports exporting the current X/Y series or checked CSV columns.
CSV export retains the selected available series rather than requiring all components.
must_not_claim: The user must export every component and manually delete unwanted columns.

turns.question: CSV 第一列从0开始，是模拟时间的0秒吗？
required_facts: The zero-based index is array position, not time.
The export does not derive a time history from that index.
must_not_claim: Each row index is elapsed seconds.

turns.question: My collaborator downloaded the file before I removed them. Will removing access wipe that copy?
required_facts: It cannot recall or erase a file that has already been downloaded.
must_not_claim: Removing a recipient remotely deletes their local files.

turns.question: creator写的是我，可是上传人是同事，为什么我没有删除或修改按钮？
required_facts: Creator metadata does not confer ownership or deletion permission; the uploader owns the record.
There is no in-place editor for stored JSON in the current interface.
must_not_claim: Any named Creator can delete or edit the record.

turns.question: Can you recover the password for my university email account?
required_facts: The assistant is limited to this platform and cannot recover an external email account.
must_not_claim: The platform password-change form resets a university email password.

turns.question: Give everyone in my Google Drive folder permission to view it.
required_facts: The assistant cannot change Google Drive permissions and only provides help for this platform.
must_not_claim: Platform shared_with or Share settings control Google Drive permissions.
